verdict.rationale: vLLM's docs explicitly list support for NVIDIA GPUs, AMD GPUs, and CPUs. They also cite hardware plugins for other accelerators (Google TPU, Intel Gaudi, Huawei Ascend, MetaX GPU, Apple Silicon, and more), and the install command auto-selects a torch backend. Vendor-tuned acceleration is only hinted at, through NVIDIA-specific NVFP4 quantization and per-scheme backend overrides. missing for 10: explicit documentation of the vendor-specific kernels used on each platform (e.g., CUDA vs. ROCm kernel paths), independent or hands-on corroboration of performance on non-NVIDIA hardware.
